thesis: NU는 v3.3에서 Compounder 조건과 Hard Veto 9개를 모두 통과했다. 고객가치·해자·재투자 수익성은 강하고 가격도 Base 아래다. 그러나 AS 63.5, FS 73.75, 90+ NPL 6.9%, 하락한 자본비율, founder voting control과 은행형 RF 방법론 불확실성이 남아 있다. 하방분산으로 mechanical band가 0-2%까지 축소된 만큼 IC는 NORMAL로 올리지 않고 STARTER 1-2%만 승인하며 macro pacing 0.5x로 분할 집행한다.

evidence.claim: Aggregate score is 78.69 with 100% core coverage; Compounder is the only eligible archetype and deterministic fit score is 81.6.
ED/RT review leaves all nine Hard Vetoes cleared, with no confirmed, unresolved or pending veto.
Locked bank-adjusted valuation is Bear $4.76, Base $18.56 and Bull $34.85 versus frozen price $14.03; price/Base is 0.7558x.
Q2 reported net income was $1.061B, ROE 33%, risk-adjusted NIM 12.4%, activity 83.5% and ARPAC $17.1, supporting strong customer economics and reinvestment capacity.
Q2 90+ NPL was 6.9%; Brazil CET1 declined to 11.9% and CAR to 15.7% as risk-weighted assets grew, although capital remained above minimums with $1.848B excess margin.
Dispersion review reduces the mechanical 2-4% band to 0-2%, and the fresh macro overlay applies a 0.5x purchase-pacing multiplier without changing the fundamental score.

counterevidence: Current price is materially below the locked Base value, so valuation support is stronger than the final STARTER state alone suggests.
ROE, risk-adjusted NIM, ARPAC and per-share earnings are improving despite continued international and product investment.
All local regulated subsidiaries remain above minimum capital requirements and retail deposits provide the dominant funding base.
The H1 buyback was executed at an average price well below the frozen Base value, supporting capital-allocation discipline.
unknowns: Full-cycle loss rates on newly expanded higher-risk credit cohorts.
Normalized Mexico/Colombia ROE and capital intensity after full banking scale.
Explicit group target capital ratios and sustainable payout ratio.
How much of the current 33% ROE persists through a weaker Latin American credit cycle.
Quantified NuFormer contribution to loss-adjusted underwriting returns.
falsifiers: ROE falls below the mid-20s for multiple periods while 90+ NPL/ECL rises and capital buffers continue shrinking.
Mexico/Colombia fail to earn returns above cost of equity after scaling, forcing recurrent equity or high-cost funding support.
A refrozen Base value falls to or below market price because distributable earnings/share no longer tracks the locked Base path.

key_kpis.name: ROE + risk-adjusted NIM + 90+ NPL
key_kpis.threshold: high-20s+ ROE with stable loss-adjusted margin and no persistent NPL deterioration

key_kpis.name: CET1/CAR excess margin
key_kpis.threshold: remain comfortably above regulatory minima as RWA expands

key_kpis.name: Per-share distributable earnings proxy
key_kpis.threshold: remain on or above the locked Base path without material dilution

next_checks: Q3 2026 NPL/ECL, ROE and capital-ratio bridge.
Mexico/Colombia profitability, deposit pricing and capital absorption.
Refreeze valuation after new capital/payout evidence or material price change.

plain_language.business: Nu는 브라질·멕시코·콜롬비아에서 신용카드, 예금, 대출, 투자와 기업금융 서비스를 모바일 중심으로 제공하는 디지털 은행이다. 지점망 비용이 낮고 고객 활동률이 높다는 점이 핵심 경쟁력이다.
plain_language.opportunity: 브라질에서 고객당 금융상품 사용을 늘리고, 멕시코와 콜롬비아를 브라질과 비슷한 수익구조로 키우는 것이 가장 큰 기회다. 현재 높은 자기자본이익률과 낮은 서비스 비용이 유지되면 장기간 복리성장이 가능하다.
plain_language.risk: 가장 큰 위험은 빠르게 커진 대출에서 연체와 대손이 예상보다 커지는 것이다. 성장에 필요한 규제자본이 늘거나 멕시코·콜롬비아가 충분한 수익을 내지 못하면 높은 자기자본이익률과 주당 가치 성장이 동시에 둔화될 수 있다.
plain_language.decision_reason: 사업 품질과 Compounder 조건은 통과했고 현재 가격도 Base 가치보다 낮지만, 신용사이클·자본비율·하방 시나리오 폭과 은행형 가치평가의 불확실성이 남아 있다. 그래서 최종 상태는 Starter 1~2%로 제한하고, 현 거시환경에서는 평소의 절반 속도로 나누어 집행한다.
